headline: EU and Indonesia Sign Landmark Trade Agreement Ending Ten Years of Talks
summary: The European Union and Indonesia signed a bilateral trade agreement removing import duties on over 90 percent of products. The deal eliminates Indonesian tariffs on European automotive exports and includes a dedicated palm oil protocol.
why: Indonesia is Southeast Asia's largest economy and a major global exporter of palm oil and critical minerals. Comprehensive free trade agreements alter international supply chains and tariff structures for industrial and agricultural goods.

impacts.name: Indonesia
impacts.why: Tariff removals boost market access for Indonesian agricultural products into the European Union.
